mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia can potentiate beta-blocker effects and increase risk of cardiac arrhythmias; loop diuretics may enhance hypotensive effects of metoprolol.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, assess blood pressure and heart rate frequently, and consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation to maintain electrolyte balance.
